mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS course_name, a.lecture_date, a.period, a.status FROM attendances a JOIN enrollments e ON a.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id JOIN students st ON e.student_id = st.id WHERE st.user_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY a.lecture_date DESC, a.period ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO excuse_requests (student_id, enrollment_id, lecture_date, period, reason, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{enrollmentId}, #{lectureDate}, #{period}, #{reason}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT er.id, er.enrollment_id, c.name AS course_name, u.name AS student_name, er.lecture_date, er.period, er.reason, er.status, er.reject_reason FROM excuse_requests er JOIN enrollments e ON er.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id JOIN users u ON er.student_id = u.id WHERE er.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY er.created_at DESC

SELECT er.id, er.enrollment_id, c.name AS course_name, u.name AS student_name, er.lecture_date, er.period, er.reason, er.status, er.reject_reason FROM excuse_requests er JOIN enrollments e ON er.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id JOIN users u ON er.student_id = u.id WHERE l.professor_id = #{professorId} AND er.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY er.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE excuse_requests er JOIN enrollments e ON er.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id SET er.status = #{status}, er.reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, er.updated_at = NOW() WHERE er.id = #{requestId} AND l.professor_id = #{professorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendances (enrollment_id, lecture_date, period, status, remarks) SELECT enrollment_id, lecture_date, period, 'EXCUSED', reason FROM excuse_requests WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'APPROVED' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'EXCUSED', remarks = VALUES(remarks), updated_at = NOW()
